about_the_game:
Buckle up and brace yourself for the most prehistoric ride of your life! Drive to Extinction throws you headfirst into a high-octane world where roaring engines clash with thunderous dinosaurs. Humanity is on the brink of extinction, and only the fastest racers stand a chance at stopping the invasion.

Upgrade your ride stats from the ground up— engines, armor, and weaponized gadgets to create the ultimate dino-fighting machine. Paint jobs and decals ensure your car reflects your style while keeping you alive against razor-sharp claws and crushing jaws.

The action never lets up:

  • Hunt or Be Hunted – Chase down colossal dinosaurs before they wreak havoc, or flip the script as towering beasts turn you into prey. Every encounter demands split-second decisions.

  • Dynamic Environments – Race through dense jungles, volcanic wastelands, and ruined islands, each filled with unpredictable hazards and ambushes.

  • Adrenaline-Packed Story Campaign – Join a team of daredevil drivers determined to push back the prehistoric menace and save the world. Every mission cranks up the danger, from raptor swarms to titanic boss encounters.

  • Replay & Challenge Modes – Master time trials, survival runs, and chaotic arena hunts to prove you’re the ultimate dino driver.

With a blend of pulse-pounding racing and relentless predator showdowns, Drive to Extinction delivers an experience where speed isn’t just thrilling—it’s survival. Do you have the courage (and horsepower) to outdrive extinction?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i3 Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 730 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1650 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 10

short_description: They are mad about the exploding dino juice that moves our cars! Speed and explore through wild environments, obtain coins with your stunts, customize your ride, takedown the dinosaurs or run away of the biggest predators. Only the boldest drivers can save humanity from the prehistoric takeover!
